reasoning: HSD8.5（outline 4.8.5）含兩個可分離的驗證標的：(1) 將 bottom 50% widget 拖入 CarPlay projection area 會被擋下並顯示 PU1291；(2) PU1291 具 OK 與 [X] 兩個關閉控制與 3 秒逾時。第 (1) 項的「拖曳被擋」與「popup 顯示」是同一觸發的連帶結果，依 §5.7 併為一條、多行 ER。第 (2) 項的 3 秒逾時需要「不操作並等待」這個與 (1) 互斥的執行路徑，無法併入同一條程序，故獨立為 033-02。OK 與 [X] 同屬使用者主動關閉，在 033-01 內以重新觸發的方式各驗一次。popup 文字、按鈕與逾時秒數一律引用 Pop Up List 的 PU1291 欄位原文，不採規格書內的轉述。優先級：拖曳限制屬 CarPlay template 的操作約束，訂 P1；逾時自動關閉屬 popup 行為細節，對主功能影響有限，訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 033-01 user-initiated dismissal (OK / [X]) after the blocked drag; 033-02 unattended 3 second timeout

tcs.test_item:
Drag and drop functionality shall not be allowed on the CarPlay template with one 50% widget on the bottom. If the user attempts to drag and drop the bottom 50% widget into the CarPlay projection area, then show popup PU1291. This popup has OK and [X] to dismiss and a 3 second timeout.

(Bottom 50% widget dragged into the CarPlay projection area -> the widget is not moved, PU1291 is displayed, and the popup is dismissed by <OK> and by <X>)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. The vehicle is equipped with a 12" Portrait display
3. Apple CarPlay is connected
4. A CarPlay layout with one 50% widget on the bottom is set on one Home Screen page
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that uses the CarPlay layout with one 50% widget on the bottom
2. Press and hold the bottom 50% widget, drag it into the CarPlay projection area and release
3. Read the popup displayed on the screen
4. Press <OK> on the popup
5. Read the position of the bottom 50% widget and of the CarPlay app
6. Press and hold the bottom 50% widget, drag it into the CarPlay projection area and release
7. Press <X> on the popup
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the CarPlay layout and one 50% widget on the bottom is displayed
2. The bottom 50% widget is not moved into the CarPlay projection area
3. Popup PU1291 is displayed with the text "Widget cannot be moved here." and the <OK> and <X> controls, as defined by PU1291 String/Popup Message
4. Popup PU1291 is dismissed
5. The bottom 50% widget remains in the bottom widget position and the CarPlay app remains in the top 50% widget area
6. Popup PU1291 is displayed again
7. Popup PU1291 is dismissed
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_4.8.5

tcs.test_item:
Drag and drop functionality shall not be allowed on the CarPlay template with one 50% widget on the bottom. If the user attempts to drag and drop the bottom 50% widget into the CarPlay projection area, then show popup PU1291. This popup has OK and [X] to dismiss and a 3 second timeout.

(PU1291 displayed and left unattended -> the popup is dismissed by its 3 second timeout)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. The vehicle is equipped with a 12" Portrait display
3. Apple CarPlay is connected
4. A CarPlay layout with one 50% widget on the bottom is set on one Home Screen page
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that uses the CarPlay layout with one 50% widget on the bottom
2. Press and hold the bottom 50% widget, drag it into the CarPlay projection area and release
3. Wait 3 seconds without pressing any control on the popup
4. Read the position of the bottom 50% widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the CarPlay layout and one 50% widget on the bottom is displayed
2. Popup PU1291 is displayed, as defined by PU1291 String/Popup Message
3. Popup PU1291 is dismissed after the 3 second timeout without any user operation
4. The bottom 50% widget remains in the bottom widget position
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_4.8.5
